integrity: Every graph and real positive cost covered by the theorem is proved analytically. A standard-library verification program supplies finite exact-rational and numeric corroboration without being an infinite proof. The originality assessment is a documented comparison, not an exhaustive literature or publication-priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Exact optimal conductance allocation only for finite one-hub bouquets of complete graphs with uniform costs within each petal edge class and a positive linear budget; does not cover general block graphs or extra edge constraints. An earlier 2006 proceedings version of the baseline source is documented, but no day-resolved public release date was verified, so the archival anchor here is the explicitly dated 2008-02-01 public electronic edition, rather than treating a conference date or manuscript submission date as publication. Independent validation is not performed.
title: Universal internal-edge cost frontier for resistance-optimal clique bouquets
